input: Get a quote for a custom fence along the driveway

gold.taskTitle: Get a Custom Driveway Fence Quote
gold.taskDescription: Research and obtain a price quote from a fencing contractor for a custom fence to be installed along the driveway.

questions.title: What is the approximate length of the driveway?
questions.description: Understanding the linear footage helps contractors give an accurate quote.

questions.title: What material do you want the fence to be?
questions.description: Common options include wood, vinyl, aluminum, wrought iron, or chain link.

questions.title: Do you have a target height in mind for the fence?
questions.description: Height affects both cost and any local permit requirements.

questions.title: What is the primary purpose of the fence?
questions.description: Knowing whether it is for privacy, security, aesthetics, or boundary marking shapes the design.

questions.title: Do you need a gate included in the fence design?
questions.description: A gate adds cost and requires decisions about placement, size, and mechanism.

questions.title: Have you already identified specific contractors to contact?
questions.description: Knowing whether you have leads determines the first outreach step.

questions.title: Is there a budget range you are working within?
questions.description: A budget ceiling helps filter contractor options and material choices from the start.
